title.en: E-2512BL — Black Glossy PET Laser-Etched Label
title.zh: E-2512BL · 黑色亮面 PET 激光刻蚀标签

tagline.en: Laser etching stops tampering — OEM traceability, assured
tagline.zh: 激光刻写杜绝篡改，原厂溯源有保障

positioning.en: E-2512BL is a dual-layer PET laser label — a black face over a white base that develops a sharp, high-contrast mark, compatible with every type of laser marker. Built with a permanent acrylic adhesive and a self-destructing facestock, it is used for automotive VIN plates, engine components, windows and warranty nameplates. It withstands −40°C to 180°C and hot oil, is laser-marked and die-cut in a single pass, and meets RoHS — enabling full-lifecycle component traceability.
positioning.zh: E-2512BL 为双层 PET 激光标签，黑面白底显色，适配全类型激光打标机。采用永久丙烯酸胶与自毁基材，用于汽车 VIN、发动机件、车窗、保修铭牌。耐 −40℃~180℃高温油污，激光打刻裁切一体成型，RoHS 环保，实现零部件全周期溯源。

en: Dual-layer PET laser facestock — laser marking is sharp and high-contrast
Self-destructs on removal, leaving a tamper trail — the label cannot be transferred or altered
−40°C to 180°C wide-temperature durability; resists oil, corrosion and abrasion
Strong permanent pressure-sensitive adhesive; the bond is even better with heat-assisted application
Laser marking and die-cutting complete in a single step — suited to automated production lines
Works on metal, plastic and glass, with a matching glass-specific laser tape available
Meets the RoHS environmental standard
zh: 双层 PET 激光基材，激光刻印高清晰高对比
揭除自毁留痕，标签不可转移篡改
−40℃~180℃宽温耐候，抗油污、腐蚀、摩擦
强力永久压敏胶，加温贴合粘力更佳
激光打标裁切同步完成，适配自动化产线
金属／塑料／玻璃通用，配套玻璃专用激光胶带
通过 RoHS 环保标准

en: Anti-counterfeit and anti-diversion — blocks refurbished or fake parts and reduces after-sales losses
Stays legible long-term across the vehicle's harsh environments — a reliable basis for traceability and warranty
Simplifies production steps; automated processing raises throughput and cuts manual error
One material for many points across the vehicle — unified procurement
Resists fall-off and rework, lowering total long-term cost of use
Size, QR code and anti-counterfeit graphics can all be customized
zh: 防伪防窜货，杜绝配件翻新造假，减少售后损耗
全车恶劣环境长期清晰，溯源保修有据可依
简化生产工序，自动化加工，提升产能减少人工误差
全车多点位通用，统一物料采购
不易脱落返工，长期综合使用成本更低
尺寸、二维码、防伪图案均可定制
